comparison.objective: Stretch and seat an O-ring without over-stretch or twist; candidate adjusts rigid proximity-switch mounts.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-loop expansion and untwisted seating versus controlled screw release, rigid sliding, registration, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Ring seated all around, ≤50% stretch and ≤90° roll; candidate needs two ≤6 mm over-center sensor states retained 3 s.
comparison.reason: The record tests seal handling, not mounted-component calibration. Candidate lacks exact screw/slot geometry and force limits.
